manifest.title: Elephant: Touch to wave
manifest.footnote: Use micro:bit V2 and the Bricks4Kidz/BrickBit servo 2 connection (P2). The simulator can show the touch event; check servo movement on the physical elephant.

reference.source: User-supplied image: on logo touched; repeat 10; blue 360 servo 2 angle 180; pause 500 ms; blue 360 servo 2 angle 0.

stages.title: Touch to command servo 2
stages.concept: An event sends a servo command when the logo is touched.
stages.adds: Start an intermediate program: on logo touched, add the blue 360 servo 2 angle block and set it to 180.
stages.predict: Which servo will receive the command?
observe: Physical build: servo 2 is sent angle 180.
stages.question: Which block detects the logo touch?

stages.title: Command 180, wait, then 0
stages.concept: A sequence sends the next command after a pause.
stages.adds: Keep the first blue servo block. Add pause 500 ms, then another 360 servo 2 angle block set to 0.
stages.predict: Which angle comes after the pause?
observe: This intermediate program sends the pair once.
stages.question: Which command follows pause 500 ms?

stages.title: Repeat the sequence ten times
stages.concept: A repeat loop runs all three enclosed blocks ten times.
stages.adds: Put angle 180, pause 500 ms, and angle 0 inside repeat 10. Touch the logo once to run the sequence ten times.
stages.predict: How many times is angle 180 sent?
observe: Touch once: ten command pairs run.
Each pair is 180, pause 500 ms, then 0.
After the loop ends, touch to run it again.
stages.question: How many pause blocks are inside the loop?
